available.counting_allocator: Public CountingAllocator and snapshot report allocation-request live bytes/peak/traffic on current thread while enabled. Does not measure allocator metadata or RSS. Dedicated profiling binary installs allocator; ordinary product does not.
available.indexed_columns: SemanticPools reports seven Vec capacity charges plus inline header; finalized concrete graph unique IDs/counts available internally.
available.bundle_facts_drop_delta: Standalone helper linked to immutable baseline lib can continuously track parse/check through dropping retained public CheckOutput/CompactDeclOutput/CompactBodyProbeOutput while arena/symbol owner/source remain alive. Snapshot delta during drop yields exact allocation-request bytes released by facts; no instrumentation required for this entire-facts bound.

existing_measurement_defects: Type::retained_bytes adds boxed root size then recursively counts it again; record entry slots include inline Type then recursive counting includes another Type. ModuleExportType/CallableType have analogous inline/root overlap.

measure_expr_types charges map entry Type then Type::retained_bytes charges its root again. BTreeMap charges use len entries and omit actual internal-node capacities/headers; FxHashMap capacity charges omit implementation control storage.

measure_check_output counts only expr_types, annotation_facts, callable_effects, function_effect_facts; omits binding/parameter/return/stage/projection/alias/constructor/requirement facts and diagnostic structures. Compact body measure counts only expr_types.

frontend_stats calls compact declarations/bodies after ast_check end_stage, leaving their allocations untracked; drops them inside enabled after_drop stage, subtracting untracked allocations with saturating live-byte arithmetic.
reported_total_bytes is assigned components_sum and reconcile_delta subtracts the two; zero is not independent reconciliation evidence.
observability.minimum_protocol: Continuously enable tracking on one thread from before all measured allocation owners are created through their destruction; snapshot instead of toggling stage enablement; emit JSON only after final snapshot. Preserve arena/symbol owner while dropping facts; no concurrent work or host effects. Report allocator-request bytes separately from RSS and inline storage. Warming unrelated caches then checking equal empty/valid/invalid cases helps expose persistent global storage; never silently subtract unowned bytes.
observability.limits: Drop delta measures bytes freed, not shared reachable bytes still retained by another owner. Entire facts include diagnostics, prepared constant data and metadata; it is not exact typing-only ownership. Mutable TypeConstraints dies before CheckOutput publication, so retained-output measurement does not measure solver peak or trails. Existing allocation counter is TLS without pointer ownership; cross-thread allocation/free invalidates live attribution.
observability.minimal_additional_instrumentation: If exact typing-only partition and all solver work counters are required, use a minimal instrumented baseline copy or profiling-only allocation tags/owner snapshots at Checker finalization and solver/probe boundaries. Expose complete ownership fields/graph IDs/capacities plus counters; independently reconcile with continuous live deltas. A standalone baseline helper can cover public retained facts but cannot observe private mutable solver state or distinguish every private fact allocation. Preserve product timing binary unchanged and retain instrumentation diff.
observability.gate_implication: Current stats semantic_retained_bytes and reconcile_delta cannot certify campaign retained typing acceptance. Required unavailable metrics must remain null/not-run until measured under a reconciled protocol.
